The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to achieve secure group communication with low overheads and that the overheads can be further reduced if the group dynamics are not completely random but follow a predictable pattern.

it is possible to achieve a scalable and efficient secure group communication over multicast with a constant message overhead per re-key operation and logarithmic overhead per simultaneous changes in the group membership.
